US-Based AI Firm Innodata Reportedly Lays Off Nearly 550 Employees in India

03 Nov 2026, 06:33 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Editorial Desk · Source: www.linkedin.com

2 min read

Key takeawaysUS-headquartered artificial intelligence services company Innodata has reportedly laid off nearly 550 employees in India, according to recent industry reports. The reported cuts represent approximately 5% of the company's total global workforce.

Report Highlights Workforce Reductions at Innodata

US-headquartered artificial intelligence services company Innodata has reportedly laid off nearly 550 employees in India, according to recent industry reports. The reported cuts represent approximately 5% of the company's total global workforce.

Reports indicate that affected workers suddenly lost access to internal company systems prior to receiving formal termination notifications. In addition to the workforce reduction in India, the company has reportedly laid off an undisclosed number of employees in the Philippines.

Context and Industry Trends

The reported layoffs at Innodata coincide with a period of broader operational assessments and staffing adjustments across the global technology sector. As tech companies navigate changing market conditions and evolving business priorities, many are reevaluating their workforce requirements.

Key aspects of the reported situation include:

  • Scale of Impact: Nearly 550 employees affected in India, representing about 5% of the global headcount.
  • Geographic Spread: Additional undisclosed layoffs reported in the Philippines.
  • Communication Method: Reports note sudden system lockouts preceding formal termination emails.

Practical Implications and Verification

For affected professionals and industry observers, navigating such employment shifts requires relying on verified channels. Because these details stem from preliminary reports and social media updates, stakeholders should look for official corporate disclosures or statements from Innodata regarding the exact scope and reasons behind the restructuring.

To verify original announcements:

  • Check official investor relations pages or press release portals managed by Innodata.
  • Review verified corporate filings if the company is publicly traded.
  • Cross-reference updates with reputable, primary journalistic sources rather than relying solely on secondary social media summaries.
